title: Woman Holding Baby Bundle Outside House, 1948 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A candid 1948 black-and-white snapshot depicting a young woman standing on a front walkway outside a suburban home while cradling a large white blanket bundle, likely a newborn baby. She is wearing a button-up blouse, dark skirt, and open-toe sandals characteristic of late 1940s fashion. Behind her is a white wooden house with a screen door and small evergreen shrubs, capturing post-WWII domestic life in middle America.
